_about: Variant 2. The ring of days. Each loop ends on its Games day; after the Games the Wardstones flare and the camp wakes on day 1. Authored numbers.

loops.name: the Proving
loops.note: the vertical slice; day 2 is the Trial, day 3 the Games

loops.name: the Second Waking
loops.note: the four discover that they all remember (bond arc may start at first_watch if the mains' trust allows)

loops.name: the Wide Ring
loops.note: Echo semifinals possible; arcs reach late states

persists.mastery: 1..4, lines and branches learned, arena tier eligibility
persists.knowings: ids of facts the player learned; a Knowing records the loop it was learned in
persists.mainsTrust: directed trust among the four mains
persists.echoStats: each stat restarts at max(1, best rank - 1)
persists.relics: at most 2 items; a Relic is granted by specific arc endings (e.g. Quill's salt-key)
persists.loopChronicle: for each main: <= 12 remembered fact ids, chosen by code by salience at each reset

resets: trust of every non-main toward the player and toward each other (authored start)
repeatedDayFastForward: a day whose inputs hash to a cached night may be lived again at speed: the player watches the cached day's cards in seconds and takes control at the first slot where they choose differently

mastery.plusOneWhen: win a Games final, or reach a Games final for the second time

endings.when: Summa final; trust(player, finalist) >= 60 AND trust(finalist, player) >= 60; both hold K-wardstones-drink
endings.result: the final becomes a 40-second duet of perfect absorbs; the Wardstones overflow; the ring breaks; the Door opens

endings.when: win the Summa final as a duel
endings.result: the ring keeps turning; the player is Rome's eternal champion and remembers every loop

endings.when: the Breaking is attempted with trust < 60 either way
Iskar's fifth circle reaches 6 members before the player reaches the Summa
endings.result: the Vigil burns the camp; a violent reset; the player loses one Relic
